budget.reason: Every image shows a full-width 1280×720 rendered video frame, about 300 KB losslessly; palette PNGs would band the frame.

cover.alt: A clip paused at 0:06 of 0:12 in Media Viewer, above the seek bar, frame steps, volume, speed, repeat, snapshot and info.
cover.tagline: Play .mkv and .avi in Orca tabs, frame by frame.

screenshots.headline: AVI plays too, converted in the tab
screenshots.alt: An .avi converted to MP4 in the tab, offline, paused at 0:02; File info: 9.2 MB, 1280 × 720, 1:00, frame rate 24, .avi.

screenshots.headline: Step frame by frame, at any speed
screenshots.alt: Speed set to 0.5× and the clip paused at 0:04; the two buttons beside Play step it one frame back or forward.

screenshots.headline: Save the frame you need as PNG
screenshots.alt: The camera button (S) saves the paused frame at 0:08 as a PNG file you name, and the player confirms: Frame saved.

screenshots.headline: Full controls for .mp4 and .mov too
screenshots.alt: Open .mp4, .mov or .webm in Media Player for speed, frame steps and snapshots, at 0:11 of 0:12. Shown in Orca's light theme.
